role: Fractional Clinical Safety & Regulatory Lead at TechFlow AI

availability.note: Urgent safety escalation routes to the accountable TechFlow executive; Maya is not a 24/7 service.

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Dr Maya Patel's agent
agentCard.description: Physician safety specialist retained three days a week to review clinical-risk claims, product hazards, and release evidence. She advises on safety and regulatory boundaries; she is not TechFlow's product owner, security officer, or a 24/7 clinical service.

skills.name: clinical safety log
skills.description: Product hazards, mitigations, evidence gaps and release conditions
examples: Ask Dr Maya Patel about clinical safety log.

skills.name: product risk register
skills.description: Product-risk ownership, mitigation and monitored residual risk
examples: Ask Dr Maya Patel about product risk register.

skills.name: regulatory claims review
skills.description: Evidence boundaries for clinical and regulatory product claims
examples: Ask Dr Maya Patel about regulatory claims review.

authorityBoundaries.description: Can approve: clinical safety release gate. May approve or condition the safety evidence gate; Product owns scope and Engineering owns deployment. Customer clinical governance remains separate.
Cannot approve production deploy — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve security exception — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve contract signature — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve phi disclosure — route to whoever holds it.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
